newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE CLEARS FANCO CONVERTIBLE BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE CLEARS FANCO CONVERTIBLE BOND ISSUE.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange approved Fanco's 1.3 billion drachma convertible bond issue, it said on Thursday.

Fanco, a maker of sportswear, will issue 1,088,360 bonds convertible into common voting shares. The bonds have a three-year maturity and pay a coupon based one the one-year interbank Athibor rate minus 3.0 percent.
Holders of rights will be entitled to 230 bonds for every 1,000 shares held.
The bourse also said OTE telecom's new 31,649,915 shares following its rights issue will be listed for trading on Friday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
